content:
We're back with this week's update on new arrivals at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to save money, with savings of up to 15%, while still purchasing directly from Apple's official website.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Premium products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a strict refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for separate purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and reduction at the Apple Certified Refurbished store so you don't have to check it yourself. Inventory changes rapidly, and the goal of this article is to keep you informed about current stock so you can snag your desired products before they're gone.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top picks in terms of price. Whether you're entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to an Apple Silicon model, both are excellent choices.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (originally $799 new)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We first reported weeks ago that the Apple Refurbished Store had the Studio Display XDR available. As we often remind you, inventory changes quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The highly sought-after entry-level Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, and the higher-end version with the Ethernet port is also available. The entry-level version typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you're looking to join the club, the Apple Refurbished Store has some attractive deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular) 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular) 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, for the latest Apple deals throughout the week, visit 9to5Toys.
